en.title: The Noise that Carries Heat
en.premise: In a city where every inconvenience has been erased and even emotions are optimized, Kai is a low-level technician tasked with maintaining 'steam pipes'—relics of a bygone era. One day, he meets Ena, a woman who, unsatisfied with digital warmth, yearns for physical 'heat.' Seeking the 'inconvenient warmth' discarded in the pursuit of ultimate efficiency, the two begin to carve a small noise into the city's silence.

zh.title: 传递热量的噪音
zh.premise: 在一个所有不便都被消除、甚至情感都被优化的城市里，主人公凯是一名在底层负责维护旧时代遗物——“蒸汽管道”的技术员。某日，他遇见了对数字化温暖感到厌倦，追求物理“热量”的女性艾娜。围绕着在追求效率的极致中被舍弃的“不自由的温暖”，两人开始在城市的静谧之中，刻下微小的噪音。
